scope: Decisions over caller-supplied alternatives: boolean, classification/routing, pairwise, ordinal, document-grounded, abstention; explicit long-context and visual-evidence gates.
amendment_policy: Targets are frozen before training. An amendment must be a dated pre-registration written before the affected run, state which target moves and why, and be recorded in research/MISSION_LEDGER.md. Moving a target after seeing a result is a protocol violation.

reference_machine.constraints: 90-minute idle drop, 12-hour session ceiling, disposable disk

banking77_suite_draw.note: different sample from the full 3,080-row test

suite_113m.note: 2,000 rows per cell except Financial PhraseBank at 1,000; one seed per cell

financial_phrasebank_ordinal.note: 3-level ordinal baseline recomputed from the stored per-example record

current_measured_baselines.ece_note: XNLI ECE is low because the model is uniform, not because it is reliable; use Brier skill and AURC as well
current_measured_baselines.latency: not measured for the Azurite product path

targets.description: The existing Banking77 path must not regress while the general decision path is added.

evaluation.split: locked legacy test, already inspected; regression only

targets.claim_if_met: The legacy Banking77 regression path is preserved.
targets.claim_if_missed: The new decision path regressed the legacy task; release is blocked.

targets.description: Answer yes/no questions over supplied evidence with caller-supplied alternatives.

evaluation.split: dev and locked; 1,500 dev / 500 locked minimum
evaluation.license_gate: record exact licence, split, and contamination status before admission

targets.claim_if_met: Boolean decisions over supplied evidence are supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: Boolean surface exists but is not a supported capability.

targets.description: Choose among arbitrary caller-supplied labels across domains, including K=2 and K=151.

evaluation.split: existing inspected test draws; dev/locked replacement required before a final claim

targets.claim_if_met: General multi-domain routing over supplied labels is supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: Classification is limited to the measured cells; no general routing claim.

targets.description: Choose between two alternatives, with tie and abstain as distinct outcomes.

candidate_sources: paired NLI/QA/retrieval items with human-verified preference labels

targets.claim_if_met: Pairwise preference decisions are supported, including explicit ties.
targets.claim_if_missed: Pairwise surface exists but is not a supported capability.

targets.description: Return an ordered judgment over ordered alternatives and respect the order in training and scoring.
targets.claim_if_met: Ordinal judgments are supported in the measured level ranges.
targets.claim_if_missed: Ordinal surface exists but is not a supported capability.

targets.description: Answer from supplied documents and return evidence spans; abstain when the documents do not decide.

evaluation.dataset: DocDecision-1, SQuAD 2.0-style extractive QA with unanswerable items
candidate_sources: internally rendered document set with known spans

controls: no-answer threshold sweep on dev only
targets.claim_if_met: Document-grounded decisions with evidence spans are supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: Document surface exists but evidence grounding is not supported.

targets.description: Return an explicit abstention when evidence is insufficient, at a stated risk and coverage.

evaluation.split: calibration on dev only; threshold frozen before locked run

controls: random abstention at the same coverage
targets.claim_if_met: Calibrated abstention at the stated risk and coverage is supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: The abstention surface exists but no reliability guarantee is made.

targets.description: Preserve decision quality at 16,384 bytes (competitive) and 32,768 bytes (stretch) relative to the 1,024-byte arm.
targets.stop_rule: A negative 4k result stops the 16k spend. A negative 16k result stops the 32k full-window spend; a chunked path may still be tested as a separate hypothesis.
targets.claim_if_met: Useful context is substantially longer than the 1,024-byte native window and at least 1.5x the Jev median prompt.
targets.claim_if_missed: The long-context claim is withdrawn; accepting more bytes is not capability.

targets.description: Use visual evidence that cannot be recovered from OCR alone.

evaluation.public_status: not admitted until licence, image provenance, and contamination gates pass

targets.claim_if_met: Visual evidence processing is supported on the measured visual-only subset.
targets.claim_if_missed: The pipeline is OCR plus text, not multimodal evidence processing.

targets.description: Scores used for thresholds must be calibrated, and confidence must rank errors better than a raw softmax.

evaluation.split: calibration on dev only; locked evaluation once

current.note: XNLI's low ECE is uniformity, not reliability

targets.claim_if_met: Calibrated reliability at the stated thresholds is supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: Confidence is descriptive only; no probability or risk guarantee.

targets.description: Local deployment with measured latency, memory, and artifact size.

current.latency: not measured for the Azurite product path

controls: onnx/int8 artifact with the same rows
targets.claim_if_met: Local deployment at the measured latency and size is supported.
targets.claim_if_missed: The model is not a local product at the claimed budget.

contract: choice_id is a supplied id or None with abstained=true
empty and duplicate alternatives are rejected
candidate-order permutation does not change the ranking beyond tolerance
scores are not probabilities unless calibrated=true
evaluation: dev and locked splits are hashed before method selection
no target or threshold is fitted on the locked split
every family has a control baseline
accuracy has a 95% Wilson interval; paired differences use paired bootstrap or exact McNemar
one seed is labelled one seed; competitive claims need three seeds or a paired design
deltas below the 1.25-point suite repeat floor are not capability claims
provenance: checkpoint SHA-256 and calibration id recorded
a generator recomputes every headline number from the stored record
negative_results: no failed run, withdrawn claim, or inconvenient result is deleted
a missed target is reported as missed
an OCR-only match is not a multimodal result
a longer accepted window with worse accuracy is a negative long-context result

not_in_scope: safety-critical credit, fraud, eligibility, or legal decisions
a multimodal claim from OCR alone
a long-context claim from a positional-embedding change without measurement
a calibrated probability claim without dev-fitted calibration and locked verification
